name: Royal Gift Wrapper for WooCommerce
author: EsLaM Hamed

sections.description:
Royal Gift Wrapper for WooCommerce enhances your store’s customer experience by offering gift wrapping and personal notes on the single product page. Perfect for holidays, birthdays, and special occasions.

Customers can write a heartfelt message and choose from multiple wrapping styles — all with a beautiful, visual selector that integrates seamlessly into your product pages.

Key Features

  • Personal Gift Notes — Let customers attach a personal message to any product.
  • Multiple Gift Wrapping Styles — Define as many wrapping styles as you want, each with a unique name and color.
  • Visual Wrap Selector — Customers pick their wrapping style from colorful swatches on the product page.
  • Custom Wrapping Fee — Optionally charge an extra fee for gift wrapping, added automatically to the cart total.
  • Order Metadata — Gift notes and wrapping choices are saved to order line item meta for easy fulfillment.
  • Enable/Disable Independently — Turn gift notes and gift wrapping on or off separately.
  • Translation Ready — Fully translatable with included .pot file and Arabic translation.
  • WooCommerce Integration — Settings page under WooCommerce menu for a seamless admin experience.

How It Works

  1. Enable gift notes and/or gift wrapping from the settings page.
  2. Define your wrapping styles with names and colors.
  3. Set an optional gift wrap fee.
  4. Customers see the options on every product page and can personalize their orders.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the royal-gift-wrapper-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Gift Wrapping to configure your settings.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and activated. The plugin will display a notice if WooCommerce is not found.

Can I set different prices for different wrapping styles?

Currently, a single wrapping fee applies to all styles. Per-style pricing may be added in a future release.

Where do I see the gift note and wrap choice after an order is placed?

The gift note and wrapping style are saved as order line item metadata. You can view them on the order edit screen in WooCommerce.

Is the plugin translatable?

Yes! It ships with a .pot template and an Arabic translation. You can add your own translations using any standard .po editor.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Standardized plugin naming and branding for WordPress.org directory compliance.
  • Added nonce verification on all form submissions for security hardening.
  • Improved output escaping and input sanitization across all files.
  • Moved all inline styles and scripts to dedicated external CSS and JS files.
  • Restricted frontend asset loading to WooCommerce product pages only.
  • Added proper internationalization support with translation template.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
